text: Inside this bright, modern environment, I sense a space shaped by curiosity and innovation. The "R+D" on the wall—Research and Development—invites me to reflect on the restless human urge to investigate and improve. The glass walls and technology displays feel both open and slightly impersonal, pulling me toward contemplation about how we balance progress with connection. Being here makes me alert and thoughtful, as if I'm standing at the threshold of new possibilities, yet also aware of the boundaries—glass, rules, expectations—that structure our collective search for knowledge.
